student_learning_goal: I can measure capacity and mass with non-standard units.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can measure capacity and mass with non-standard units.
header.character_watermark: Cal the Calendar Cat in the top-right with a stopwatch and pan balance. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 container pairs, circle which holds MORE.
parts.visual_layout: Four container pairs side by side with cup-count labels and a more circle for each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 capacity compare layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 4 container pairs: pail (6 cups) vs bowl (4 cups), bottle (3 cups) vs jug (8 cups), mug (1 cup) vs glass (2 cups), tank (10 cups) vs bucket (5 cups). Each with MORE circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_CAP at Part 1: keywords name the container pairs capacity comparison.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 pan balance images, write HEAVIER, LIGHTER, or EQUAL.
parts.visual_layout: Four pan balance images with answer lines for the heavier, lighter, or equal label.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 pan balance layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 4 balance images: 1 apple vs 3 grapes (apple heavier), 1 pumpkin vs 1 squash (equal), 1 book vs 5 papers (book heavier), 1 pencil vs 1 eraser (about equal). Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_BAL at Part 2: keywords name the pan balance images for mass reading.

parts.student_instructions: If a pail = 6 cups and 1 cup = 2 scoops, how many SCOOPS?
parts.visual_layout: A pail icon with a cup-and-scoop conversion line and an answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 unit-convert layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. Pail icon. Below: '6 cups × 2 scoops/cup = ___ scoops.' Convert from cups to scoops.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_CONV at Part 3: keywords name the cups to scoops convert task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find an item in your bag with mass less than your pencil.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — check unit-attribute reasoning.
